result.title: Visual-to-Executable Procedural Reconstruction of Buildings
result.summary: Procedural modeling offers compact, editable, and reusable representations for architectural content, but building such models still depends heavily on manually authored grammars. We study image-based procedural building reconstruction from in-the-wild images, with the goal of recovering an executable procedural description that can be instantiated as an editable 3D building asset. Because a single image provides only partial and view-dependent evidence, we focus on recovering the dominant visible facade(s) and attach the recovered facade program to a simple mass model for building-level instantiation. Our method decomposes this task into two structured prediction stages. First, a Global Structure Layout Tree recovers facade-scale split-and-repeat organization through a fine-tuned layout model with render-guided visual-symbolic reflection. Second, a Component Parameterization schema maps representative facade tiles to structured procedural attributes for local architectural component synthesis. These two representations are then deterministically compiled into executable Computer Generated Architecture (CGA) programs, avoiding the brittleness of direct low-level program generation. Experiments show that the proposed framework handles both regular facades and challenging in-the-wild images, while maintaining high structural consistency, procedural executability, and fine-grained architectural detail. The recovered programs further enable controllable and reusable 3D building asset generation.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究从单张 in-the-wild 图像重建可执行的程序化建筑模型：先用微调布局模型预测立面尺度的 split-and-repeat 结构布局树，再把代表性立面 tile 映射为结构化组件参数，最后确定性编译为可执行 CGA 程序并挂接到简单体块模型上，得到可编辑的 3D 建筑资产。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结构化中间表示＋确定性编译」避免直接生成低层程序，以及基于渲染结果的视觉—符号反思校正环节，可能为 LVR 中中间状态设计与视觉证据核验提供方法线索；但任务域属 3D 程序化重建，与 VLM 推理距离较远，需核查该反思是否真的回写并更新状态，仅供备选阅读。
